title: Grateful Dead Live at Rainbow Theater on 1981-10-02
source: Set 2, Beyer M-160 (x2) > Sony TCD5M / CM > C1 > C2 (Maxell UDXLII-C90); Cassette 2 (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1KHz) > CD Wave Editor > Soundforge 9 (patch) > Trader's Little Helper > Flac16  Transfer, edit, & patch by Bob Morris, May 2012

ai_review.summary: Audience recording sounds wonderful, though no performance details are provided.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the audio quality, calling it "wonderful" and hoping a master copy exists, which suggests a clear and pleasant audience capture. No comments were made about the musical performance, setlist flow, or individual band members, so those aspects remain unassessed.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review highlights excellent sounding audio but provides no insight into the show itself; rating reflects strong recording quality with unknown performance merit.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, pleasant sound; reviewer notes no issues and wishes for a master copy, indicating high satisfaction with the capture.
